{{Term/Store|Water of Life|Water of Life|Series, TAoL}} is a recurring [[Item]] in {{TLoZ Series}}.<ref>{{Cite Book|quote= |book= E |publisher= |page= 142 {{Exp Game|TAoL}}}}</ref>

==Location and Uses==
==={{TAoL|-}}===
The Water of Life is hidden in a cave just west of the [[Midoro Palace]] and must be given to an Old Woman in the [[Harbor Town of Mido]] who asks Link for his help in saving her sick daughter.<ref>{{Cite|PLEASE. MY DAUGHTER IS SICK. HELP HER!|Old Woman|TAoL}}</ref> To enter the cave, Link must have the [[Hammer]] to break the [[Boulder]] sealing it. The Water of Life itself is guarded by three [[Daira]]s. After returning the Medicine to the elderly woman, she rewards Link by allowing him inside her house,<ref>{{Cite|THE WATER OF LIFE! QUICK COME WITH ME.|Old Woman|TAoL}}</ref> where he meets an [[Old Man]] who teaches him the [[Magic of The Adventure of Link#Fairy|Fairy]] magic.<ref>{{Cite|THIS MAGIC WORD WILL GIVE YOU POWER.|Old Man|TAoL}}</ref>

==Other Appearances==
==={{ZG&W|-}}===
{{Noncanon|Start}}
{{Descriptions ZG&W}}
In {{TLoZGW}}, Link may carry a single bottle of the Water of Life at a time. This bottle will contain a single dose of the Potion, which will automatically heal Link to the maximum five hearts if he should die.<ref name="gameandwatch9">{{Cite Manual|quote= This is automatically used when Link's life has reached zero and revives him with up to five hearts. It can also be used whenever you need it by pressing the bottom of the + Control Pad to revive LINK's life to its maximum. However, Link can have only one bottle on him at one time and it can be used only once.|game= ZG&W|page= 9}}</ref> The Water of Life can also be used voluntarily at any point.<ref name="gameandwatch9"/>
{{Noncanon|End}}

===''The Legend of Zelda'' (Valiant Comics)===
{{Noncanon|Start}}
The Water of Life appears in the {{TLoZ (Valiant Comics)}}. In "''[[Trust Me]]''", after the townsfolk of the [[Water Town of Saria]] build a dam following [[Princess Zelda|Zelda]]'s advice since their land was infertile, the dam unfortunately does not work and the princess comes to the conclusion that the land is cursed. At that moment, [[Ganon]] appears and presents a bottle which contains the magical Water of Life,<ref>''The '''Magical Water of Life''''' - Ganon (''Valiant Comic Issue #2'')</ref> and says that it will heal Saria's fields.<ref>''[It] will restore your fields, giving you all the food you need!'' - Ganon (''Valiant Comic Issue #2'')</ref> However, he refuses to give it over until Link is captured, and the desperate citizens do so to obtain the Water of Life from the Prince of Darkness.<ref>''...After you '''capture''' the evil Link!'' - Ganon (''Valiant Comic Issue #2'')</ref>
{{Clear|Left}}
{{Noncanon|End}}

==={{TFoE|-}}===
{{Noncanon|Start}}
[[File:TFoE Water of Life Sprite.png|32px|left]]
In {{TFoE}}, Water of Life is used to recover Link's health and is the only form of recovery during a stage. Link can carry Water of Life inside of [[Empty Bottle|Canteens]] he receives from certain characters. The Canteen can be refilled by [[Hamish]] and the [[Fairy|Fairies]] of [[Spearfish Falls]], as well as by bottles of Water of Life found in [[Fortress Centrum]], [[Glutko]], [[Lupay (Stage)|Lupay]] and [[Serigon Caves]]. If Link does not have a Canteen, then the Water of Life they give will simply restore his health.
{{Noncanon|End}}

==={{TWoG|-}}===
{{Noncanon|Start}}
Water of Life is used in {{TWoG}} to recover Zelda's health. It is the only way to recover health during a stage. Zelda can carry Water of Life inside of [[Empty Bottle|Canteens]] she receives from certain characters. The Canteen can be refilled by the Fairies of the [[Fairy Pool]]. If Zelda does not have a Canteen, then the Water of Life they give will simply restore her health.
{{Noncanon|End}}
